headline: Revenue and margins climb, but a tax swing sinks earnings
summary_short: Dynatrace's shard-tracked quarter (report date March 31, 2026) posted revenue of $531.7M, up 19.4% y/y, with operating income up 30.2% y/y to $55.9M, while net income fell 55.7% y/y to $17.4M on a much smaller tax benefit than a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 19.4% y/y to $531.7M and operating income grew 30.2% y/y to $55.9M, tracking Dynatrace's fiscal-2026 (year ended March 31, 2026) story of 19% annual revenue growth from existing-customer expansion and new-customer adoption, and 18% ARR growth to $2,053.6M. Net income fell 55.7% y/y to $17.4M and diluted EPS fell to $0.06 from $0.13 — annually, this reflects a $137.1M FY2026 tax expense versus a $260.3M FY2025 tax benefit tied to a one-time IP-transfer deferred tax asset that didn't recur. Total cash rose 7.9% y/y to $1.097B; shareholders' equity was roughly flat at $2.611B. The 10-K discloses no forward guidance range. No dividend.
